description: Analyzes academic performance and provides scoring with detailed insights

excellent.description: High-priority tasks completed first and on time

good.description: Most high-priority tasks done on time

average.description: Some tasks completed regardless of priority

performance_levels.description: You are performing exceptionally well. Your dedication and consistency are paying off.
performance_levels.next_steps: Focus on maintaining this level. Consider mentoring peers or taking on leadership roles in study groups.

performance_levels.description: Solid performance with room for improvement in specific areas.
performance_levels.next_steps: Identify your weakest metric and focus improvement efforts there. Small improvements can push you to outstanding.

performance_levels.description: You're on track but there are clear areas that need attention.
performance_levels.next_steps: Build consistency in your study routine. Focus on completing tasks on time and increasing daily study hours.

performance_levels.description: Your performance needs significant improvement. Don't worry — we can build a plan to help.
performance_levels.next_steps: Start with small, daily study goals. Seek help from peers or tutors. Use the AI planner to structure your time.

performance_levels.description: Immediate attention needed. Your academic progress is at risk.
performance_levels.next_steps: Schedule a meeting with your academic advisor. Start with just 30 minutes of focused study daily. Join a study group for support.

trend_analysis.improving: Your performance is trending upward. Keep up the positive momentum!
trend_analysis.stable: Your performance is consistent. Consider pushing for the next level.
trend_analysis.declining: Your performance has been declining. Let's identify what's changed and address it.
trend_analysis.fluctuating: Your performance varies significantly. Building a consistent routine will help stabilize results.
